newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Southern starts Guangzhou-LA service Apr 28.
newsitem.headline: China Southern starts Guangzhou-LA service Apr 28.

text.p: China Southern Airlines Co will start direct flights between Guangzhou and Los Angeles on April 28, China's semi-official China News Service said on Thursday.
The route will be served by a Boeing 777, the report quoted a company official as saying.
The Guangzhou-based carrier will add three Boeing 737 aircraft to its fleet this year, the news agency said.
China Southern will inaugurate Haikou-Shantou-Kuala Lumpur service on April 3, the report said.
Haikou and Shantou are southern Chinese cities.
Officials from the airline were not immediately available to comment.
China Southern, one of the three largest state-owned airlines in China, owns and operates a fleet of about 90 aircraft.
It has the biggest Boeing fleet in China with 62 aircraft.
